---
title: "Metadata Creation Tools"
format: html
---
Federally funded data are required to include standardized metadata with common attributes in a consistent format to support documentation. 
All NOAA environmental data must have:
- Title
- Geographic and Temporal Extents
- Citation Information
- Abstract about the dataset
- Keywords
- Data License Information

This is achieved by the National Environmental Archive by 
* following the International Organization for Standardization (ISO). 
* NetCDF templates
* Creating Data Management Plans

:::{.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Useful Templates to follow

[ISO 19115-2 Gridded data and Imagery Workbook](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/sites/default/files/2024-07/ISO%2019115-2%20Workbook.pdf)
[NCEI's NetCDF Templates](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/netcdf-templates)
[Federal Geographic Data Committee's Standards and Guidelines](https://www.fgdc.gov/metadata/geospatial-metadata-standards#fgdcendorsedisostandards0
:::
